verdict.rationale: A government IP office with an open-data portal could publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas or a data dictionary, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows one: the docs cover filing procedures, and the probe only shows data.inpi.fr returning 403 to keyless requests, with no specification visible.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
